title: 1RB0LE_1LC0RE_0RA0LD_1LA1LF_0LC0RE_1LE---: after the C-wave
text: After the C-wave of a change of stage of 1RB0LE_1LC0RE_0RA0LD_1LA1LF_0LC0RE_1LE---, the rest of the change is local: the head stays within 77 cells left of the event cell, the new stage starts with Z empty and its first item on the next cell, and the halting state F is entered 1,381 times, always on a 0 (all 186 changes in 150 stages, py/stage_change.py transient). The rule for the new first item is still open.
